key_insight: The paper presents a validated, reproducible lattice Boltzmann dataset and pipeline for benchmarking neural surrogates on turbulent 3D obstructed channel flows.
engineering_relevance: It provides a standardized foundation for comparing surrogate models on realistic CFD tasks such as forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction in turbulent flow engineering.
method: Generate 3D channel-flow datasets around synthetic geometries at Re=1,000–10,000.
Use a cumulant-collision lattice Boltzmann solver with grid-convergence verification.
Plan benchmark tests for FNO and U-Net variants using physics-informed metrics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation against experimental Strouhal number, drag coefficients, and turbulent fluctuations, plus grid studies at 1024×512×512 resolution.
watch_item: The surrogate benchmark results are still planned, so practical performance claims and generalization limits remain unproven.
paper_title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
